title: How One Assassination Started World War I
title_alternatives: The Assassination That Started World War I
How One Bullet Led to World War I
Sarajevo 1914: The Road to World War I
description:
One bullet in Sarajevo in 1914 did not cause World War I alone. Here is how an assassination, tangled alliances and rival empires pulled Europe into war in six weeks.

This documentary traces the road to the First World War: the alliance system, Balkan nationalism, imperial rivalry, the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, the July ultimatum, mobilisation by rail, and the declarations of war that followed.

This is Episode 1 of Wars That Shaped the World, a series on wars from different eras and the changes they left behind. Next: the Napoleonic Wars. Like, subscribe and share to follow the series.
